# B5 golden payload

`b5_matched_message.json` was generated by executing the pure `build_messages`
functions from keep-event-handler commit `0ad3b199d09e3e41c3d6940d8298d1a1c535044b`
(PR #54). The generator excludes infrastructure imports; it does not reproduce
the builder implementation. Run:

```text
python tests/fixtures/generate_b5_fixture.py <path-to-keep-event-handler>
```

The input is a synthetic, already-normalized alert snapshot. This verifies the
producer's wire shape, not AlertDto parsing or raw Kafka replay. B5 owns assigning
a per-occurrence `id` and preserving it across raw retries and DLQ redrive.
Consumer tests verify matched-message redelivery, distinct IDs for the same
fingerprint, reused IDs, and malformed ID-less deliveries without inventing IDs.
